candidate.changes: Ten changes: (1) the Desktop asks the canonical gateway for one batch clarify request (clarify_batch on prompt.submit), gated so a legacy hermes serve sidecar and an older gateway are not broken; (2) the canonical gateway replays an open batch clarify, with its locked answers and drafts, in session.resume and session.events.since; (3) a clarify timeout shows one settled card, not two; (4) 'Show drafts saved on the server' and 'Discard drafts' survive the settled card's remount; (5) renderer robustness: offline edits re-sent, expired replies, method-not-found memos, cleared drafts and late acknowledgements; (6) compute-host (turn isolation) child relay for clarify.draft and clarify.drafts.discard, a Linux-tested, POSIX-only feature; (7) draft-store hardening (Windows directory ACLs, atomic replace, deleted named profiles, un-encodable UTF-8, persistence errors, .tmp residue) and settle_batch ignoring client-supplied drafts keys; (8) server drafts purged at session deletion through hermes_state_common.emit_session_deleted for every reason except archive; (9) hermes profile create --clone-all no longer copies clarify_drafts; (10) Desktop isolation: userData decided before modules read it, a commit build never registers the OS hermes:// handler, and a commit build uses its own gateway lock directory. Detail and files: docs/clarify-candidate/HANDOFF.md
